_description: E-076a, the TEST arm: the same 7-million-parameter cone codec on the same global tensor as f7l0-cone-7M-twin, with one thing changed — the ocean's interior no longer enters as a gridded map. The 32 channels of the Argo depth column are not read from the tensor at all; instead, for every anchor, the five nearest real Argo profiles are found in the observation store (within 1,000 km and 30 days, never later than the anchor's own five-day bin) and each becomes a set of measurement tokens carrying its own distance east and north in kilometres, its age in days, the pressure of each level, how many profiles were in range at all, and the footprint saying that this is a point measurement taken in minutes rather than a monthly average of a 1-degree box. The claim being tested is that a measurement is never missing, only far away, and that a model told HOW far away can use it better than one handed a map that fills the gaps for it. Half the anchors additionally have their nearest profile taken out of the input and asked for instead, which is both the training objective and the thing the two arms are scored on: the nearest real profile's temperature and salinity at sixteen depths, in degrees Celsius and PSU, against the seasonal normal and against copying the next-nearest profile. Everything else — geometry, masking plan, held-out years, learning rate, batch, the two extra dot fields — is identical to the twin, so a difference between the two runs is a difference in how the interior enters the cone and nothing else.
_provenance: Written 2026-09-07 for E-076a, the ablation of ml/plans/E076_family8_nearest_observations.md section 5, against the control f7l0-cone-7M-twin. k = 5, R_max = 1,000 km and T_max = 30 days are section 2.3's arithmetic from the float array's own density (about 2,000 profiles per pentad worldwide, so the fifth neighbour sits at roughly one surface correlation length); the store is the one built and published on 2026-09-07 by ml/build_family8_argo.py (family8-build #3, 2,678,439 profiles over 1,535 live pentads, 234 MB, documented in docs/FAMILY8_DATA_HANDOVER.md). The withhold probability of 0.5 is E-076 section 7.5's masked-profile objective at half weight, so the run also trains on the ordinary reconstruction it is compared under.
